# linux_archive_extract (Resource)

Extracts an archive that is on the host, such as one fetched with `linux_download`, into a directory. Files already in the directory are replaced, even running programs. Destroying the resource removes the extracted files, and the directories they leave empty, but not the destination directory. Every change extracts the archive again. The archive is not watched: to extract a new version that has the same path, reference its digest in `triggers`. Needs `tar` on the host, with `gzip`, `bzip2` or `xz` for compressed archives, or `unzip` for zip archives.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Install node_exporter from its release tarball, and run it with systemd.
locals {
  node_exporter_version = "1.12.1"
  node_exporter_sha256  = "b51d8a76aa2a9156a55d501aca6276fae09e262259a5e4e831d2c2222f084e63"
}

resource "linux_download" "node_exporter" {
  url    = "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v${local.node_exporter_version}/node_exporter-${local.node_exporter_version}.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
  sha256 = local.node_exporter_sha256
  path   = "/opt/archives/node_exporter.tar.gz"
}

# The tarball holds node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64/node_exporter: with
# strip_components = 1, the binary lands in /opt/node_exporter/node_exporter.
resource "linux_archive_extract" "node_exporter" {
  source           = linux_download.node_exporter.path
  destination      = "/opt/node_exporter"
  strip_components = 1

  # Extract again when a new version is downloaded.
  triggers = {
    sha256 = linux_download.node_exporter.sha256
  }
}

resource "linux_file" "node_exporter_unit" {
  path    = "/etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service"
  content = <<-EOT
    [Unit]
    Description=Prometheus node exporter
    After=network-online.target

    [Service]
    User=nobody
    ExecStart=/opt/node_exporter/node_exporter
    Restart=on-failure

    [Install]
    WantedBy=multi-user.target
  EOT
}

resource "linux_systemd_unit" "node_exporter" {
  name          = "node_exporter.service"
  enabled       = true
  active        = true
  daemon_reload = true

  # Restart on upgrades and unit changes.
  triggers = {
    binary = linux_download.node_exporter.sha256
    unit   = linux_file.node_exporter_unit.sha256
  }

  depends_on = [linux_archive_extract.node_exporter]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Absolute path of the directory to extract into. It is created if needed.
- `source` (String) Absolute path of the archive on the host.

### Optional

- `format` (String) Format of the archive: `tar`, `tar.gz`, `tar.bz2`, `tar.xz`, `zip`, `gz`. A `gz` file holds a single file, extracted under the name of the archive without `.gz`. Defaults to the format given by the extension of `source`.
- `strip_components` (Number) Number of leading directories to remove from the paths in the archive, like `tar --strip-components`: with `1`, `node_exporter-1.8.2.linux-amd64/node_exporter` is extracted as `node_exporter`. Defaults to `0`.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that extract the archive again when they change, such as the `sha256` of the `linux_download` resource that fetched it.

### Read-Only

- `files` (List of String) Extracted files, relative to `destination`, sorted. Directories are not listed.
- `id` (String) Random identifier.
